About Us: 
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:
LRM Team Sales Operation team drives sales planning and execution through target setting, performance tracking, accurate reporting, data-driven insights, process management, and timely operational support to improve productivity and achieve business goals.

About the role
We are strengthening our Sales Planning and Distribution Strategy capability for Lending. As a Data Analyst, you will partner closely with the planning lead to turn business questions into clear analysis, models, and insights that drive sales planning, distribution design, and performance tracking. You will own day-to-day execution — data prep, analysis, dashboards, and scenario support — so leadership can make faster, better decisions.

Key responsibilities
-Support sales planning cycles (targets, capacity, territory/portfolio coverage, and resource allocation) with robust data and analysis
-Build and maintain models for demand forecasting, productivity, channel/partner performance, and distribution effectiveness
-Analyse sales funnel, conversion, and portfolio metrics to surface trends, gaps, and opportunities
-Design and refresh dashboards / MIS for leadership reviews (weekly / monthly / quarterly)
-Run scenario and what-if analyses for planning decisions (e.g., target stretch, channel mix, geographic prioritisation)
-Partner with Sales, Credit, Operations, Finance, and Product to reconcile definitions, pull data, and validate insights
-Ensure data quality, documentation, and consistent metric definitions across planning deliverables
-Translate analytical findings into crisp recommendations and presentation-ready narratives for leadership

Required skills & experience
-4+ years of experience as a Data Analyst / Business Analyst in BFSI, preferably Lending, retail banking, or related domains
-Strong proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets (advanced formulas, pivot tables, modelling)
-Hands-on experience with SQL for data extraction and analysis
-Experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent)
-Solid analytical problem-solving: structuring ambiguous asks, building hypotheses, and delivering actionable insights
-Comfort working with large datasets and reconciling numbers across multiple sources
-Clear written and verbal communication — able to explain analysis to non-technical stakeholders
-Preference for candidates from reputed institutions with strong quantitative / analytical academic background

Good to have
-Exposure to sales planning, MIS, distribution strategy, or go-to-market analytics.
-Exposure to AI tools.
-Familiarity with Python or R for analysis / automation
-Experience with CRM / LOS / LMS data, or sales force effectiveness metrics
-Prior work supporting AVP/VP or similar leadership stakeholders in a fast-paced environment


Why join us:
We support our people by providing a range of flexible working options so they can work in the way that best suits them. We also offer you the opportunity to develop your career, working in a diverse and inclusive workplace where the diverse backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people are celebrated and create a great place to grow, thrive and belong. Most importantly, for us Work is Fun!!

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users,21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. jobs.description_html:
Role Summary:
The Area Sales Manager holds accountability for the health insurance sales performance of a ten-member Relationship Manager team in Delhi NCR. The role encompasses building the team, establishing and sustaining the daily field rhythm, coaching the sales pitch, and delivering the monthly premium target through open-market sourcing.

This is a hands-on, field-based leadership role. The Area Sales Manager is expected to be present in the market alongside Relationship Managers — covering territories, participating in customer meetings, and supporting case closures with the team.


Key Responsibilities:
Own and deliver the team's monthly premium target.
Drive login-to-issuance conversion by resolving documentation, medical scheduling, and underwriting pendency in coordination with the operations team.
Conduct the daily morning huddle, spend structured time in the field with Relationship Managers, and audit lead quality to ensure MIS records accurately reflect field activity.
Build and maintain the team by screening, interviewing, and onboarding Relationship Managers, allocating territories based on candidate residence.
Maintain quarterly Relationship Manager attrition below 10%. Sustain an average ticket size of at least ₹15,000 by prioritising family floater and port-in cases within the sales pitch.
Keep free-look cancellations below 5% of gross premium and enforce compliance standards across all open-market sales activity.

Pre Requisites:
Five to eight years of experience in field sales, including a minimum of two years managing a frontline sales team against individual and team targets.
Prior experience in a target-driven field sales environment within the direct sales channel of Health Insurance, Life Insurance, General Insurance, or BFSI.
Proven track record in hiring, developing, managing, and retaining frontline sales teams.
Strong understanding of Delhi NCR markets, with the ability to operate across multiple locations and regions.
Sound knowledge of health insurance products, including features, benefits, exclusions, and customer needs.
An established local network and strong market connect across Delhi NCR. Ownership of a vehicle and willingness to undertake extensive daily field travel.
Comfort operating within a highly field-oriented and target-driven environment.

jobs.description_html:
Hiring | Treasury & Capital Markets | Paytm

About Paytm
Paytm is one of India’s leading digital financial services platforms, serving 450M+ consumers and 45M+ merchants. We are building the next generation of financial services by combining technology, scale and innovation to create seamless experiences for consumers and businesses.
We are looking for an experienced Treasury professional to join our Corporate Treasury & Capital Markets team.

About the Role
The role will be responsible for managing funding, liquidity, banking relationships, debt capital markets, treasury operations, investments and regulatory compliance.
This is a strategic treasury role requiring strong exposure to debt instruments, capital markets, banking relationships, cash management and treasury accounting, along with the ability to work closely with internal and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities / KRAs
1. Capital Markets & Debt Management
Structure, execute and manage CPs, NCDs and Term Loans
Coordinate with credit rating agencies, merchant bankers, debenture trustees, institutional investors and banks
Support fundraising and debt optimization initiatives
Manage financing documentation, security creation and ROC/CERSAI filings
Monitor debt portfolio, repayment schedules and borrowing costs

2. Liquidity & Treasury Investments
Manage daily cash positioning and liquidity across bank accounts
Optimize surplus funds across money market instruments, mutual funds and fixed-income investments
Drive cash-flow and working-capital forecasting
Ensure efficient deployment of funds and minimize idle cash

3. Banking Relationships & Treasury Operations
Manage strategic relationships with banks and financial institutions
Negotiate banking facilities, pricing and credit limits
Oversee H2H, CMS and online banking platforms
Manage banking access controls, signatory matrices, payment gateways and collection accounts
Support internal, statutory and regulatory audits

4. Treasury Accounting, MIS & Reporting
Ensure accurate treasury accounting through SAP FICO/TRM
Manage accounting for interest accruals, loan repayments, borrowing costs and treasury transactions
Build and monitor MIS covering debt, liquidity, interest costs, yield and risk metrics
Present treasury insights to senior leadership

5. Regulatory Compliance & Governance
Ensure adherence to treasury policies and regulatory requirements
Monitor RBI guidelines, FEMA and KYC requirements
Ensure timely treasury-related regulatory filings
Manage ROC/CERSAI registrations and documentation
Drive continuous improvement in treasury processes and controls

Must-Haves

8–10 years of post-qualification experience in Corporate Treasury, Capital Markets, Banking or Financial Institutions
CA / MBA Finance / CFA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Finance
Strong hands-on experience in Debt Capital Markets and Corporate Treasury
Exposure to CPs, NCDs, Term Loans and debt fundraising
Strong understanding of liquidity and cash-flow management
Experience managing banking relationships and treasury operations
Working knowledge of SAP FICO/TRM
Strong understanding of RBI, FEMA, KYC and treasury compliance
Experience with ROC/CERSAI charge creation and filings
Strong stakeholder management and analytical skills

Location: Mumbai

Why Paytm?

At Paytm, you get the opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, financial services and large-scale digital commerce.
Work with one of India's most recognized digital financial services platforms
Opportunity to manage high-scale treasury and capital market operations
Work closely with senior leadership, banks, financial institutions and capital market stakeholders
Be part of a fast-paced environment where technology and finance come together
Solve complex, high-impact problems at significant scale
Build and shape treasury practices in a dynamic and evolving financial services ecosystem

jobs.description_html:
About the Role

We are looking for a commercially driven Partnerships Manager to build and scale new monetization channels through strategic partnerships.
The role will be responsible for identifying, negotiating, launching, and growing partnerships across third-party publishers, affiliate partners, advertising platforms, research companies, and other ecosystem partners.
This is a hands-on role spanning the entire partnership lifecycle — from identifying the right partners and negotiating commercials to contracting, product/tech integration, launch, and ongoing revenue growth.
The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of digital monetization and have previously created or scaled revenue channels through partnerships, rather than simply managing existing partner relationships.

What You Will Do

1. Build the 3P Publisher Business
Identify and build relationships with third-party publishers/platforms with monetizable inventory.
Develop the partnership proposition, commercial model, and go-to-market approach for bringing publishers onto the platform.
Evaluate publisher opportunities based on inventory quality, scale, monetization potential, economics, and strategic fit.
Own the partner lifecycle from initial outreach and commercial discussions through integration, launch, and scale.
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Ad Operations, Data, and other teams to onboard and scale publisher partners.

2. Build New Monetization Partnerships
Identify and develop partnerships across multiple areas, including:
Advertising / AdTech partners
Third-party publishers
Affiliate / commerce partners
Market research and survey companies
Demand- and supply-side platforms
Other emerging monetization partners and platforms

3. Commercial Negotiations & Deal Closure
Lead commercial discussions with prospective and existing partners.
Structure commercials, revenue shares, pricing, and incentive mechanisms that create sustainable economics for both parties.
Negotiate contracts, commercials, SLAs, and other partnership terms.
Work closely with Legal, Finance, and other internal teams to close agreements and get partnerships live.
Own the commercial relationship throughout the partnership lifecycle.

4. Grow and Monetize Existing Partnerships
Develop relationships with existing partners and identify opportunities for incremental revenue and business growth.
Track partner performance and identify opportunities to improve revenue, yield, volume, and margins.
Build joint business plans with strategic partners.
Identify new use cases, inventory, products, or geographies that can expand the partnership.
Act as the commercial owner for the partner relationship.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

7–10 years of experience in partnerships, business development, monetization, AdTech, affiliate, digital media, publisher partnerships, or related areas.
Strong experience in building revenue/monetization channels through external partnerships.
Experience working directly with publishers, advertising partners, affiliate platforms, research companies, AdTech companies, or other digital ecosystem players.
Demonstrated ability to identify, negotiate, and close commercial partnerships.
Strong commercial understanding, with the ability to discuss revenue share, pricing, margins, yield, incentives, and business economics.
Experience taking partnerships from concept → negotiation → contract → integration → launch → scale.
Comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Operations, and Sales.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and improve partner economics.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.

Good to Have
Experience in AdTech / digital advertising / publisher monetization.
Experience with 3P publisher ecosystems and advertising inventory monetization.
Experience with rewarded advertising, offerwalls, surveys/research, affiliate commerce, or performance marketing.
Existing relationships across publishers, AdTech platforms, research companies, or affiliate ecosystems.
Experience working in a high-growth environment where partnerships need to be built from scratch rather than managed through an established playbook.

Role Summary:
The Relationship Manager is responsible for the direct sale of health insurance to customers within an assigned market territory in Delhi NCR. The role sources business across three parallel channels — the Paytm Merchant base, open-market prospecting, and customer referrals — and owns the end-to-end customer journey, from the first conversation through to policy issuance.

Engage Paytm Merchants within the assigned territory to introduce health insurance offerings and develop relationships through consistent, repeated interactions.
Independently prospect in the open market across individuals, families, salaried professionals, and small business owners to generate new business.
Systematically generate referrals from issued customers, engaged merchants, and personal networks, ensuring a referral request accompanies every policy delivery.
Conduct a thorough needs analysis for each prospect and recommend the most appropriate product from the approved insurer panel.
Manage customer objections effectively, close cases, and ensure complete and accurate documentation is collected at the point of sale.
Minimise free-look cancellations by ensuring customers purchase products that genuinely meet their needs and that they fully understand.

Pre Requisites:
Minimum of one year of experience in Health Insurance or General Insurance.
Prior experience in Direct Sales is mandatory.
Graduate degree in any discipline (minimum qualification).
Strong communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills. Local candidate with an established presence in, and understanding of, the Delhi NCR market and community.
Demonstrated comfort with field sales, customer acquisition, lead generation, and regular market visits. Ownership of a two-wheeler and willingness to undertake daily field travel.

It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started. 

Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 corridors in real time. In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

We are looking for a commercially minded, execution-oriented Senior Commercial Counsel to support Nium’s next phase of global growth. You will serve as a trusted legal partner to our commercial, partnership, treasury, compliance, and executive teams, leading complex transactions across payments, card issuance, treasury, and digital asset and stablecoin-enabled solutions. Success requires exceptional commercial judgment, a pragmatic mindset, and the ability to deliver clear, business-focused advice at speed.

Our Legal Team

We are known for Speed, Clarity, and Trust. We move quickly without sacrificing judgment, give practical advice that helps teams act with confidence, and focus on enabling growth and navigating complexity. The best candidates are commercially minded, highly responsive, intellectually curious, and energised by complex problems.

jobs.description_html:
About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Role- 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Business Insights & Growth
- Drive data-led growth across the acquisition, retention, churn, revenue and GMV lifecycle.
- Own deep-dive analytics to identify key drivers and opportunities for acquisition, engagement, retention and churn reduction.
- Drive Revenue and GMV growth in line with the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) through actionable insights and growth recommendations.

Customer & Lifecycle Analytics
- Analyse cohorts, journeys, segments and behavioural trends to improve customer lifetime value and repeat transactions.
- Build cohort and retention frameworks (D0/D7/D30, monthly triangles) across new, reactivated and repeat users.
- Diagnose churn and cancellation drivers and recommend structural fixes, not surface-level corrections.

Campaign Efficacy & Attribution
- Measure and optimize campaign efficacy — identifying the right segments, propositions, channels and levers to maximize incremental GMV and revenue.
- Conduct funnel, cohort, campaign and attribution analysis to identify performance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
- Reconcile promotional burn against incremental GMV; establish ROI and cost-per-incremental-user benchmarks by campaign and segment.
- Analyse A/B tests and control-group experiments to isolate true incrementality.

Metrics, Dashboards & Models
- Build and track key business metrics, dashboards, performance frameworks and analytical models to monitor growth against AOP.
- Own metric definitions and data integrity; maintain a single source of truth across teams.
- Develop forecasting and scenario models for GMV, revenue and user base to support planning cycles.

Stakeholder Partnership
- Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Growth, DWH and Business teams to convert insights into measurable outcomes.
- Translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives for senior stakeholders and drive data-backed decision-making.
- Own analytical inputs for MBRs and business reviews — with a clear storyline, not just charts.

REQUIREMENTS
Experience
- 8-10 years of experience in business analytics, growth analytics or data science — preferably in consumer internet, fintech, e-commerce or financial services.
- Demonstrated ownership of a product vertical or growth charter with measurable business impact.
- Experience with large-scale transactional and behavioural datasets in a high-velocity consumer business.

Technical Skills
- SQL — advanced: complex joins, window functions, CTEs and query optimization on large distributed datasets (Trino/Presto/Hive/Redshift/BigQuery).
- Python — pandas, numpy, statistical testing and automation; modelling libraries a plus.
- Advanced Excel — pivots, complex formulas & macros
- Data Modelling — dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, event and funnel data structures, metric-layer design.
- Data Visualization — Tableau, Power BI, Superset or equivalent; dashboards that get used, not just built.
- Product & Web Analytics — Google Analytics, CleverTap, Mixpanel, Amplitude or Firebase for funnel and journey analysis.

Analytical & Business Capabilities
- Strong command of cohort analysis, funnel analysis, retention curves, LTV modelling, attribution methodologies and experiment design.
- Comfort with significance testing, regression, segmentation and clustering techniques.
- Commercial instinct — able to connect a metric movement to the underlying business mechanic and the money at stake.
- Excellent communication; able to defend a recommendation with evidence in front of senior leadership.

Education
- Bachelor’s in Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or a related quantitative discipline. MBA or Master’s in a quantitative field preferred.

GOOD TO HAVE
- Exposure to wealth, investments, savings or commodity-linked products.
- Experience with SIP / recurring-payment analytics, including mandate and autopay behaviour.
- Familiarity with pricing, margin and unit-economics analysis.
- Experience mentoring junior analysts.

CORE COMPETENCIES
- Diagnostic mindset — pushes past the symptom to the root cause.
- Rigour — validates counts and stress-tests assumptions before publishing.
- Ownership — treats the business target as their own.
- Clarity — reduces complexity to a decision, not a data dump.
- Constructive dissent — challenges assumptions and targets with data, early.

Why join us: 
Work with a high-performing and passionate product, design, and engineering team. 
Shape the future of credit for millions of users. 
Build at scale in one of India’s most dynamic and regulated spaces. 
Flexible and inclusive work environment with fast decision-making and ownership. 

Compensation: 
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 25 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

About Paytm:
Paytm is one of India’s leading digital financial services platforms, offering a wide range of services across payments, financial services, commerce, and digital products. With a large and diverse technology ecosystem, Paytm operates at significant scale and works across multiple technology and business domains.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Associate – Tech Hiring to join our Talent Acquisition team. The role will be responsible for driving end-to-end technology hiring, with a strong focus on sourcing, bulk hiring, hiring drives, and stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage end-to-end recruitment for technology roles across multiple levels and functions.
- Drive bulk hiring for tech positions while ensuring quality and turnaround timelines.
- Own strong candidate sourcing through LinkedIn, Naukri, employee referrals, databases, and other relevant channels.
- Conduct proactive sourcing and build a strong pipeline of tech talent across various skill sets.
- Plan and execute walk-in/virtual hiring drives and other volume-hiring initiatives.
- Partner closely with hiring managers and business stakeholders to understand hiring requirements, priorities, and timelines.
- Manage multiple open positions simultaneously and ensure timely closure of mandates.
- Screen candidates, conduct initial assessments, coordinate interviews, and drive the process through offer and joining.
- Maintain regular communication with candidates and ensure a positive candidate experience.
- Track hiring metrics, pipeline status, closures, and other recruitment MIS.
- Work closely with HRBPs and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth onboarding and joining.
- Identify and implement innovative sourcing strategies to improve hiring efficiency.

Mandatory Requirements:

- 2–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment, with strong exposure to Technology hiring.
- Hands-on experience in end-to-end tech recruitment.
- Strong expertise in sourcing and candidate pipeline building.
- Proven experience in bulk/volume hiring for technology roles.
- Experience in planning and managing hiring drives.
- Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work closely with hiring managers and business teams.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight hiring timelines.
- Strong communication, negotiation, and candidate management skills.
- Experience working in a fast-paced technology, fintech, internet, or startup environment would be preferred.

jobs.description_html:
About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Role 
We’re looking for a Visual Design Intern who can bring craft, taste, and a strong sense of direction to Paytm’s visual language — someone who thinks beyond a single polished screen and can translate everyday, utility-first product moments into visuals that feel considered and unmistakably Paytm. You’ll work on illustration, iconography, and visual systems for product surfaces used at scale — sourcing references, building a point of view, and executing that direction with craft, alongside designers and stakeholders across the team. Throughout the internship, you’ll have a dedicated design mentor, participate in design critiques, and learn how a considered visual direction gets built, defended, and scaled across a product.

What You’ll Do 
● Source and synthesize references into an original, defensible visual direction — not just execute a given style.
● Translate a product’s emotional tone — trust, playfulness, urgency, calm — into visuals that serve that specific context.
● Collaborate with product designers, product managers, and the design team to keep visual language consistent with the brand.
● Contribute to and help extend Paytm’s evolving visual systems (illustration, iconography, motion) for use across products.
● Use AI tools as part of your craft process, while maintaining a distinct, non-generic point of view.
● Take feedback, iterate fast, and improve visual quality with every round.

What We’re Looking For
● Final-year student pursuing a degree in Design, Visual Communication, Illustration, Animation, or a related field.
● Strong visual and illustration fundamentals — composition, form, colour, and craft.
● Ability to source references thoughtfully and synthesize them into an original direction, not just imitate them.
● An eye for translating brand identity across different tones and contexts — playful, premium, utilitarian, and beyond.
● Hands-on experience with design/illustration tools (Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar); familiarity with AI tools as part of the workflow.
● Motion & graphics sensibility is a strong plus.
● Curiosity, ownership, and openness to feedback.
● A portfolio with strong visual range and process — show us your references, explorations, and decisions, not just polished final visuals.

Why Join Us? 
● Design for real impact  
Your visuals will live inside a product used at scale.
● Learn from experienced designers
Get dedicated mentorship, regular critiques, and feedback.
● Grow through collaboration  
Work closely with cross-functional teams and learn through continuous 360° feedback.
● Be part of the team
Build strong relationships with peers and mentors through ownership, craft and contribution. 

How to Apply  
Share your resume and portfolio through the application form.
We want to understand how you think.
Show us your process, explorations, decisions, iterations, and final outcomes - not just polished designs.

jobs.description_html:
About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Team
Recharges & Utilities is a core business pillar for Paytm, spanning 20+ essential categories including Mobile Recharge, Electricity, DTH, and Loans. As a Manager on this team, you will be the “Growth Engine” — using deep data insight to identify opportunities and executing high-impact campaigns to acquire and retain millions of users.

About the Role
Analytical Execution & Category Growth
We're looking for a high-ownership individual who is as comfortable writing SQL queries in Hive as designing a marketing campaign. You will own the full data lifecycle of your assigned categories and use that data to drive P&L growth and user retention — increasingly with AI tools like Claude as your everyday co-pilot for analysis, automation, and campaign creation.

Core Roles & Responsibilities
1. Data Operations & Analytics (The “How”)
- Data Extraction: Perform daily data extraction and prepare user-readable transaction reports.
- Query Management: Write and optimize SQL queries day-to-day to track business health and run ad-hoc deep dives.
- Automation: Use Advanced Excel and internal tools to automate recurring reports, streamlining MIS for leadership.
- Data Modeling: Translate business questions (e.g. “Why is electricity bill churn increasing?”) into data models that surface actionable answers.
- AI-Assisted Analysis: Use Claude or similar AI assistants to draft and debug SQL/queries, summarize large datasets, and produce first-pass insights — then apply your own judgment to validate and sharpen the output before it informs a decision.

2. Growth & Category Management (The “What”)
- P&L Support: Help deliver revenue targets by optimizing costs and identifying bottom-line-enhancing strategies.
- User Lifecycle: Identify specific user cohorts (e.g. “lapsed rent payers”) and run custom growth campaigns to drive activation and reactivation.
- Funnel Optimization: Monitor the user journey from landing to transaction; identify drop-offs and implement funnel improvements.
- Retention & GMV: Own key metrics including Daily Active Users (DAU), GMV, and month-on-month (MoM) retention.

3. Marketing & Campaign Execution
- ROI Analysis: Measure the performance of every campaign to ensure marketing spend drives efficient growth.
- Competitive Intelligence: Track market trends and competitor offerings to keep Paytm's utility categories ahead.
- AI-Powered Campaign Ideation: Use Claude/AI copilots to draft campaign briefs, personalize messaging by cohort, and rapidly prototype copy and creative variants for A/B testing.

4. AI-First Working Style
This role expects you to treat AI tools as a core part of how you work, not an optional add-on:
- Daily AI Fluency: Comfortable using Claude (or a similar AI assistant) as a co-pilot for SQL writing, Excel/report automation, data storytelling, and building stakeholder-ready summaries.
- Prompt Craft: Able to break a business problem into clear prompts for AI tools to accelerate first-draft analysis — while retaining the judgment to sense-check and refine anything AI-generated before it's shared or acted on.
- Automation Mindset: Proactively spot repetitive MIS/reporting work that can be offloaded to AI tools or scripts, freeing up time for higher-order strategic work.
- Responsible Use: Understands data-privacy and confidentiality boundaries when using AI tools with business data (e.g. no PII or sensitive data in external prompts without approval).

Superpowers & Skills Required
- Experience: 4–6 years in a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Growth role (preferably in E-commerce, Retail, or Fintech).
- Technical Proficiency: Advanced Excel (VBA/Macros a plus) and strong SQL skills; experience with Hive, BigQuery (BQ), or Python for data manipulation.
- AI Tool Proficiency: Hands-on experience using Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI tools for coding, data analysis, or content generation is a strong plus — and a genuine interest in using AI to work faster is expected.
- Analytical Mindset: Background in Engineering, Math, Statistics, or Economics; able to see the story behind the numbers.
- Execution Grit: Follows through on projects, coordinating with cross-functional teams (Product, Tech, Marketing) to get things to the finish line.
- Communication: Clear, effective communication for sharing updates with stakeholders and senior management.

Why join us? 
● A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology
● Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
● A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
● Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation: 
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 17 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants - and we are committed to it. India's largest digital lending story is brewing here. It's your opportunity to be a part of the story!

jobs.description_html:
About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Role
UPI is the backbone of India's digital payments revolution — and Paytm is one of its largest participants, processing hundreds of millions of transactions every month. We are looking for a Product Manager to join our UPI team and drive product strategy, user growth, and experience excellence across our UPI-powered flows.
This role sits at the intersection of consumer behaviour, financial infrastructure, and regulatory nuance. You will own high-impact product surfaces and work closely with engineering, design, data, and business teams to ship products that millions of Indians use daily.

Key Responsibilities
1. Analytics Strategy & Ownership
- Own the end-to-end analytics charter for one or more UPI surfaces — from metric definition to instrumentation to insight generation
- Build and maintain the source-of-truth framework for north-star and guardrail metrics across the UPI funnel (initiation, authentication, success/failure, retention)
- Partner with NPCI-mandated reporting requirements and ensure analytical rigor aligns with regulatory data standards
- Lead a team of analysts, setting priorities, reviewing outputs, and raising the bar on analytical craft

2. Funnel, Growth & Behavioural Insights
- Diagnose friction points across the UPI journey using deep-dive analysis, cohort studies, and funnel decomposition
- Build engagement, frequency, and top-of-wallet models to inform product and growth strategy
- Design analytical frameworks for discovery and nudge effectiveness as new UPI capabilities are adopted
- Partner with design and product research to combine quantitative and qualitative signals into a single narrative

3. Platform Reliability & Scale Analytics
- Define and monitor SLA, success-rate, and latency benchmarks; build alerting and anomaly-detection frameworks tied to these metrics
- Build root-cause analysis playbooks for payment failure spikes and incident-linked drop-offs
- Model traffic and failure patterns ahead of high-volume events (festive seasons, IPL, government disbursements) to support platform readiness

4. Experimentation & Decision Science
- Own the experimentation backbone — design, power, and evaluate A/B tests across the UPI funnel
- Drive a test-and-learn culture: hypothesis → experiment → read-out → scale, with statistically sound methodology
- Build self-serve dashboards and tooling that let product, engineering, and business teams access trusted insights without analyst dependency
- Proactively surface insights that shape upstream roadmap and prioritization decisions

Required Qualifications
- 7–9 years of analytics/data experience, with a mandatory focus on consumer-facing products or fintech; prior experience in payments or UPI strongly preferred
- Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, or equivalent); working knowledge of Python/R for deeper statistical analysis
- Solid grounding in experimentation design — hypothesis framing, sample size/power calculations, and interpreting A/B results correctly
- Proven ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear, decision-ready recommendations
- Experience building and owning dashboards and metrics frameworks at scale, including data quality and governance practices
- Strong written and verbal communication skills — ability to present findings crisply to leadership and align cross-functional stakeholders
- Experience managing or mentoring a team of analysts, with a demonstrated ability to review work and raise analytical standards

Good to Have
- Prior experience working in a UPI-regulated environment or with NPCI data/reporting constructs
- Exposure to large-scale transaction data systems and familiarity with data warehousing/pipeline concepts (e.g., working with data engineering teams on instrumentation)Experience with growth, lifecycle, or CRM-driven analytics
- Familiarity with fraud/risk analytics in a payments context

Why Join Us
- Work on one of India's most critical financial infrastructure products — UPI — at massive scale
- Join a high-performance analytics org embedded deeply with product and engineering, with a bias for shipping insights that matter
- Influence decisions that affect hundreds of millions of transactions every day
- Operate in a fast-moving, ownership-driven culture where analytics leads have real authority — and real accountability

Compensation
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500 mn+ registered users, 25 mn+ merchants, and unmatched transaction data depth, Paytm is uniquely positioned to define the next chapter of UPI in India — and we want you to help write it.

jobs.description_html:
About Paytm:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Team:
QR/Soundbox team is one of the biggest business and payments vertical in the organisation that is focused on merchant acquisition, merchant retention and growth of merchants in India.

About the Role: Paytm is looking for an experienced sales professional & people manager to be a part of the QR & Sound Box vertical.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Growth of distribution and market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility & accountability through extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product .
3. Identify and recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Plan the market size, span and geographies for ASMs .
5. Devise best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
6. Monitor the quality parameters as suggested by the management.
7. Validate and conduct audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
8. People manage a large team of 5-10 ASMs & 200+ indirect employees.

Must Have: 
Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application the new learnt ideas and concepts.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. Self-starters, who can take ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, will be an ideal fit. 8-12 years experience in sales - business development, B2C markets
2. Passionate about working in a fast growing firms and large team handling.
3. Articulate complex solutions to novice customers.
4. Good sales and negotiation skills. Experience in quota driven sales is a must.
5. Experience in payments and finance is a plus - though not mandatory.


Why join us:
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Compensation: 
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you.
With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

jobs.description_html:
About the Role

UPI is the backbone of India's digital payments revolution — and Paytm is one of its largest participants, processing hundreds of millions of transactions every month. We are looking for an Analytics Lead to join our UPI team and own the data and insights charter that powers product, growth, and platform decisions across our UPI-powered flows.This role sits at the intersection of consumer behaviour, financial infrastructure, and large-scale data systems. You will build the analytical backbone for UPI — from funnel and cohort frameworks to experimentation infrastructure — and work closely with product, engineering, data science, and business teams to turn transaction-scale data into decisions that affect millions of Indians daily.

Key Responsibilities

1. Analytics Strategy & OwnershipOwn the end-to-end analytics charter for one or more UPI surfaces — from metric definition to instrumentation to insight generationBuild and maintain the source-of-truth framework for north-star and guardrail metrics across the UPI funnel (initiation, authentication, success/failure, retention)Partner with NPCI-mandated reporting requirements and ensure analytical rigor aligns with regulatory data standardsLead a team of analysts, setting priorities, reviewing outputs, and raising the bar on analytical craf
t2. Funnel, Growth & Behavioural InsightsDiagnose friction points across the UPI journey using deep-dive analysis, cohort studies, and funnel decompositionBuild engagement, frequency, and top-of-wallet models to inform product and growth strategyDesign analytical frameworks for discovery and nudge effectiveness as new UPI capabilities are adoptedPartner with design and product research to combine quantitative and qualitative signals into a single narrative
3. Platform Reliability & Scale AnalyticsDefine and monitor SLA, success-rate, and latency benchmarks; build alerting and anomaly-detection frameworks tied to these metricsBuild root-cause analysis playbooks for payment failure spikes and incident-linked drop-offsModel traffic and failure patterns ahead of high-volume events (festive seasons, IPL, government disbursements) to support platform readiness
4. Experimentation & Decision ScienceOwn the experimentation backbone — design, power, and evaluate A/B tests across the UPI funnelDrive a test-and-learn culture: hypothesis → experiment → read-out → scale, with statistically sound methodologyBuild self-serve dashboards and tooling that let product, engineering, and business teams access trusted insights without analyst dependencyProactively surface insights that shape upstream roadmap and prioritization decisions

Required Qualifications
7–9 years of analytics/data experience, with a mandatory focus on consumer-facing products or fintech; prior experience in payments or UPI strongly preferred
Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, or equivalent); working knowledge of Python/R for deeper statistical analysis
Solid grounding in experimentation design — hypothesis framing, sample size/power calculations, and interpreting A/B results correctlyProven ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear, decision-ready recommendations
Experience building and owning dashboards and metrics frameworks at scale, including data quality and governance practices
Strong written and verbal communication skills — ability to present findings crisply to leadership and align cross-functional stakeholders
Experience managing or mentoring a team of analysts, with a demonstrated ability to review work and raise analytical standards

Good to Have
Prior experience working in a UPI-regulated environment or with NPCI data/reporting constructs
Exposure to large-scale transaction data systems and familiarity with data warehousing/pipeline concepts (e.g., working with data engineering teams on instrumentation)
Experience with growth, lifecycle, or CRM-driven analytics
Familiarity with fraud/risk analytics in a payments context

jobs.description_html:
About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Role
UPI is the backbone of India's digital payments revolution — and Paytm is one of its largest participants, processing hundreds of millions of transactions every month. We are looking for a Product Manager to join our UPI team and drive product strategy, user growth, and experience excellence across our UPI-powered flows.This role sits at the intersection of consumer behaviour, financial infrastructure, and regulatory nuance. You will own high-impact product surfaces and work closely with engineering, design, data, and business teams to ship products that millions of Indians use daily.

Key Responsibilities
1. Core UPI Product Ownership-
- Own end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and execution for one or more UPI surfaces
- Drive seamless payment flows: initiation, authentication, success/failure states, and post-transaction experience
- Continuously improve funnel metrics — conversion, success rate, and drop-off — through A/B testing and experimentation
- Work with NPCI guidelines and stay ahead of regulatory changes to ensure compliance without compromising experience

2. User Experience & Growth
- Identify friction points in the UPI journey using data, user research, and support insights, then ship targeted fixes
- Design and launch features that drive engagement, frequency of use, and top-of-wallet positioning
- Own discovery and nudge strategies that help users adopt new UPI capabilities
- Collaborate with design to maintain a fast, trustworthy, and intuitive payment experience

3. Platform Reliability & Scale
- Define success metrics (SLAs, success rates, latency benchmarks) and hold engineering accountable to them
- Build escalation frameworks and incident response playbooks for payment failures
- Ensure platform readiness for high-traffic events such as festive seasons, IPL, and government disbursements

4. Insights & Experimentation
- Build and maintain dashboards that track north-star and guardrail metrics across the UPI funnel
- Drive a culture of rapid experimentation — hypothesis → test → learn → scale
- Generate and socialise insights that influence upstream decisions in engineering, design, and business

Required Qualifications
- 3–5 years of product management experience with a mandatory focus on consumer-facing products or fintech
- Deep understanding of user psychology, engagement funnels, and conversion mechanics in high-frequency consumer apps
- Proven ability to translate ambiguous problems into structured hypotheses and ship fast, iterative solutions
- Comfort with SQL and product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, or equivalent)Strong written and verbal communication skills — ability to write crisp PRDs, present to leadership, and align cross-functional stakeholders
- Demonstrated ownership mindset: you have shipped features end-to-end across product, engineering, and go-to-market

Good to Have
- Prior experience working in a UPI-regulated environment or with NPCI product constructs
- Experience with 0→1 product development alongside maintaining and scaling existing surfaces
- Exposure to growth, lifecycle, or CRM-driven product work

Why Join Us
- Work on one of India's most critical financial infrastructure products — UPI — at massive scale
- Join a high-performance product org with strong engineering depth and a bias for shipping
- Influence product decisions that affect hundreds of millions of transactions every day
- Operate in a fast-moving, ownership-driven culture where PMs have real authority — and real accountability

Compensation
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500 mn+ registered users, 25 mn+ merchants, and unmatched transaction data depth, Paytm is uniquely positioned to define the next chapter of UPI in India — and we want you to help write it.

jobs.description_html:
About the Team

MAS's mission is to accelerate the build and deployment of an AI workforce for every business — from kirana to conglomerate. Our vision is to deliver a billion-plus workflows through our agents in ways that drive real client outcomes, not automation for its own sake.

We go deep rather than wide. Today that means known, process-defined, repeatable service workflows — inbound contact-centre work (calls, chats, tickets), plus the outbound work that behaves like a cost workflow rather than a conversion one (lead qualification and verification, not lead conversion) — anywhere we can benchmark against a cost line the client already feels, guarantee savings, and hold the quality bar. We're deliberately building a technology company, not an AI BPO: models are a commodity, so our moat is the workflow knowledge, integrations, and client relationships that only come from actually running the work — not a generic AI layer bolted onto a call centre.

We've proven this model works — with marquee clients across consumer durables, auto, and D2C/marketplace businesses — and we're still early. We'll keep evolving it as we go, staying client-first rather than assuming we already have the answer. This is a 0–1 business inside Meesho: no fixed playbook, high ownership, and the ground floor of how India's enterprises adopt AI-led operations.

About the Role

This role is for a GTM generalist who thrives in ambiguity, is genuinely excited about AI-led offerings, and wants to build the full range of enterprise sales skills — with an eye on growing into a closer and sales leader over time, or moving into Business/GTM Operations. Both are real paths from this seat.

You own the middle mile of the deal: the stretch between a qualified conversation and a close-ready opportunity. That means deep client discovery, mapping who really decides, understanding how a client's teams actually work today, and making sure the deal never goes cold on your watch — following up, keeping momentum, and setting up the closer to walk into the room fully briefed. Our central team owns top-of-funnel lead-gen, but this isn't a purely inbound or coordination role — you'll still make cold calls and run early client meetings yourself when a deal needs it.

A lot of enterprise AI-services deals across this market stall before signature for a simple reason: nobody on the deal ever gets deep enough into the account to know what the client is actually buying, or who really decides. That's exactly the gap this role exists to close — the middle mile is where deals live or die.

jobs.description_html:
About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Role Purpose
The Finance & Reporting Manager will support the CFO in building and managing Paytm Europe's core finance function, with responsibility for financial accounting, statutory and regulatory reporting, tax, treasury, and management information. This is a hands-on role requiring strong ownership and the ability to operate effectively in a lean, regulated, and fast-growing business.
Key Responsibilities
Accounting & Financial Reporting
-Manage the end-to-end accounting cycle, including general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, fixed assets, accruals, provisions, and balance sheet reconciliations
-Review accounting entries and reconciliations to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of the Company's financial records
-Manage monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring accurate and timely completion
-Prepare and review financial statements under Lux GAAP and support Group reporting under IFRS, where applicable
-Oversee the work of the external fiduciaire and other accounting service providers, including preparation of statutory accounts and supporting schedules
Regulatory Reporting & Financial Controls
-Coordinate Finance-owned regulatory and prudential reporting to the CSSF and other relevant authorities, including own-funds and applicable financial returns
-Support the Finance aspects of safeguarding and related reporting and controls concerning client funds, working closely with the Payments Finance & Reconciliation Manager and relevant control functions
-Develop, implement, and maintain financial policies, controls, and procedures appropriate to a regulated Payment Institution
-Ensure appropriate segregation of duties, approval authorities, and financial controls are embedded across Finance processes
-Work closely with Compliance, Risk, Internal Controls, and other functions to ensure Finance meets its regulatory responsibilities
Audit
-Act as the principal Finance point of contact for external auditors and coordinate the annual statutory audit
-Prepare and maintain audit files, supporting schedules, and other financial evidence required for audit and assurance activities
-Coordinate Finance support for internal audit reviews and ensure agreed Finance-related remediation actions are implemented
Tax
-Manage corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and other applicable Luxembourg tax obligations, working with external tax advisers as required
-Ensure tax filings and related payments are accurate and completed within required deadlines
-Monitor relevant changes in Luxembourg tax and regulatory requirements and assess their financial implications for the Company
Banking, Treasury & Liquidity
-Manage day-to-day banking relationships and Finance activities relating to the Company's bank accounts
-Monitor cash positions and maintain cash-flow and liquidity forecasts to ensure appropriate funding of the business
-Support the CFO in treasury, funding, and liquidity management decisions
-Maintain appropriate controls over the Company's own funds and banking activities
Budgeting, Forecasting & Management Information
-Lead the preparation and ongoing management of budgets, forecasts, and financial models
-Prepare monthly management information and financial reporting for the CFO, senior management, and Board
-Monitor financial performance against budget and forecast, providing clear variance analysis and commentary
-Develop financial analysis and insights to support commercial and strategic decision-making
-Support the CFO in monitoring the Company's financial performance, cost base, and overall financial plan
Finance Processes, Systems & Business Support
-Establish and document scalable Finance processes, controls, and SOPs appropriate to the Company's stage of development and growth
-Identify and implement opportunities to automate and improve accounting, reporting, and other Finance operations
-Support the selection, implementation, and ongoing development of accounting, ERP, and other Finance-related systems
-Provide Finance input into new products, commercial initiatives, system implementations, and other cross-functional projects
-Work collaboratively across the business and with Group Finance to ensure the Finance function supports the Company's growth while maintaining appropriate financial discipline and control

About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Key Responsibilities
Payment Transaction Accounting
-Own end-to-end accounting for payment transaction flows across acquiring, ensuring accurate recognition of transaction volumes, merchant fees, interchange, scheme charges, and other payment-related revenues and costs
-Ensure payment processor and scheme settlement reports are accurately mapped and recorded within the general ledger
-Oversee accounting for settlement, safeguarding, and suspense accounts, ensuring appropriate classification and treatment of timing differences
-Review payment-related journal entries and ensure completeness and accuracy ahead of monthly and year-end close
-Ensure appropriate accounting treatment of transaction-related receivables and payables, refunds, reversals, chargebacks, and scheme fee accruals
-Support accurate revenue recognition and transaction cost reporting
-Work with Product, Operations, and payment partners to ensure new products, payment flows, schemes, and processor changes are correctly reflected in the accounting framework
Safeguarding & Reconciliation
-Own the financial reconciliation and control framework supporting the safeguarding of client funds, ensuring balances are accurately identified and reconciled in accordance with applicable requirements
-Review and sign off daily and periodic reconciliations between internal ledgers, processor and scheme reports, settlement accounts, and bank statements
-Establish escalation thresholds and resolution timelines for reconciliation breaks, ensuring material or aged items are investigated to root cause and resolved
-Act as the Finance escalation point for complex reconciliation and settlement issues, working with processors, banking partners, and internal teams
-Ensure safeguarding and reconciliation processes, controls, and documentation remain audit-ready and capable of supporting regulatory reporting
-Drive improvements in reconciliation tooling, automation, and control design as transaction volumes and payment methods scale
Payroll Accounting & Oversight
-Review payroll outputs, payroll accounting, and related reconciliations
-Coordinate with payroll providers and internal teams to ensure accurate processing and accounting
-Oversee the Finance aspects of statutory deductions, payments, and submissions, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
Financial Reporting, Audit & Controls
-Support monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes and financial reporting under Lux GAAP and, where applicable, IFRS
-Support Finance inputs into CSSF and other applicable regulatory reporting, particularly around safeguarding and payment activities
-Support external and internal audits, including preparation of reconciliations, schedules, and supporting evidence
-Maintain financial controls, documentation, and procedures across areas within the role's scope
Management Information & Business Insight
-Produce clear management information on transaction volumes, payment revenues, transaction costs, and settlement/reconciliation performance
-Support monthly management and Board reporting, including analysis of payment economics and emerging trends
-Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis relevant to payment activity and transaction costs
-Provide financial insight to the CFO and wider management team to support commercial and operational decision-making
Processes, Systems & Automation
-Establish and document scalable processes and SOPs for payment accounting, reconciliation, and safeguarding-related Finance activities
-Drive automation of high-volume reconciliation and transaction-accounting processes to reduce manual intervention as the business scales
-Support implementation and development of accounting, reconciliation, and other Finance systems
-Work cross-functionally with Finance, Product, Operations, Technology, and external partners to embed financial controls into new payment products and processes from the outset

jobs.description_html:
About Us
Paytm is India's leading financial services company that offers full-stack payments & financial solutions to consumers, offline merchants, and online platforms. The company is on a mission to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through payments, commerce, banking, investments, and financial services. One97 Communications Limited, which owns the Paytm brand, was founded by Vijay Shekhar Sharma.

Role Overview
We are looking for a high-impact Lender Partnerships & Business to drive our digital lending partnerships. In this role, you will own strategic relationships with banks and NBFCs, lead the complete credit funnel, drive unit economics, and launch innovative financial products to scale India’s largest lending platform.

Key Responsibilities

1. Own Lender Relationships & Business
Own day-to-day and strategic relationships with banks, NBFCs, and institutional lending partners.
Act as the primary business interface for assigned lender partnerships.
Understand lender priorities, risk appetite, products, commercials, and business objectives.
Drive regular business reviews with partners and identify strategic opportunities for growth.
Build strong relationships across business, product, credit, operations, and technology teams at partner organizations.

2. Funnel & Business Performance
Own the complete lending funnel—from sourcing and application to approval, disbursal, and portfolio performance.
Track key metrics including leads, applications, approvals, conversion, disbursals, Turnaround Time (TAT), rejection rates, and revenue.
Identify funnel leakages and work with internal and external teams to improve conversion rates and customer experience.
Develop business dashboards and actionable insights to drive day-to-day performance.
Own business targets and ensure delivery against agreed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

3. Product & New Business Initiatives
Identify new opportunities to grow the lending business with existing and new partners.
Translate customer, market, and lender requirements into compelling new product propositions.
Work closely with product, technology, credit, operations, and risk teams to launch new capabilities.
Drive initiatives such as new loan products, customer segments, user journeys, pricing, offers, underwriting models, and distribution channels.

4. Commercials, Billing & Revenue
Own commercials and business terms with lending partners in collaboration with internal stakeholders.
Ensure accurate tracking of partner-wise revenue, fees, incentives, and other commercial components.
Own the billing and reconciliation process with lenders.
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies and commercial leakages.
Maintain a deep understanding of unit economics and the overall profitability of each partnership.

5. Business Planning & Growth
Develop partner-wise business plans and long-term growth strategies.
Identify opportunities to increase disbursal volumes, revenue, and margins.
Build solid business cases for new initiatives and partnerships.
Monitor market trends and competitive developments, translating them into actionable growth strategies.
Continuously optimize the economics and scalability of the lending business.

6. Cross-functional Leadership
Work closely with Product, Technology, Credit, Risk, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Analytics teams.
Drive execution across multiple cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
Ensure initiatives are delivered within agreed timelines and aligned with business objectives.
Represent the lending business internally, ensuring partner requirements are effectively translated into technical and operational execution.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Experience: 6 to 12 years of hands-on experience in core digital lending (Consumer Loans, MSME Loans, Merchant Credit, or Co-lending).
Domain Expertise: Proven track record of managing bank/NBFC partnerships, managing loan funnels, and negotiating commercial structures.
Analytical Mindset: Comfortable using data dashboards to track conversion metrics, TAT, unit economics, and portfolio health.

jobs.description_html:
Job Overview
Lead and manage all aspects of risk management for Paytm Money's Market Risk and MTF operations, ensuring compliance with exchange regulations and protecting the company's financial health while facilitating optimal trading activity.
 
Principal Accountabilities
• Develop and implement risk management frameworks specifically tailored for stock market activities, including:
o Equity market risk (systematic and non-systematic)
o Derivatives market risk (futures, options)
o Margin Trading Funding (MTF) risk (client exposure and internal limits)
o Liquidity risk (ability to meet financial obligations)

• Design and implement stress testing scenarios to assess portfolio resilience under various market conditions (volatility spikes, crashes, sector downturns).
• Monitor real-time market data and key risk indicators (KRIs) to identify and proactively mitigate emerging risks.
• Oversee risk limits for client positions and trading activities, ensuring adherence to position sizing and leverage guidelines.
• Liaise with regulatory bodies and ensure timely reporting of market risk exposures and CTCL reporting
 
Major Challenges
• Balancing risk mitigation with maximizing profitable trading opportunities for clients.
• Adapting risk management strategies to respond to volatile market conditions and changing market dynamics.
• Implementing effective risk controls for complex financial instruments and trading algorithms.
• Maintaining a strong risk culture within the trading environment, balancing risk awareness with fostering a proactive trading approach.
 
Decision
• Internal Clients: Setting risk limits for client accounts, approving margin extensions.
• External Clients: Negotiating risk parameters with clearing houses and other counterparties, managing credit risk associated with counterparty exposure

About Role:

The ideal candidate should be a strong product thinker, execution leader, customer advocate, and stakeholder manager, with hands-on experience in building and scaling digital products. Experience in FinTech, lending, payments, Internet, or e-commerce is highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the product vision, roadmap, prioritisation, and execution for one or more product areas.
* Translate customer, business, and market problems into clear product requirements and scalable solutions.
* Drive products/features through the complete lifecycle — discovery → definition → development → launch → measurement → iteration.
* Lead feature launches and product releases, ensuring strong execution, adoption, and measurable business impact.
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Analytics, Business, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams.
* Manage multiple high-priority and concurrent product initiatives in an Agile environment.
* Own customer-facing experiences and continuously improve UX, conversion, engagement, and customer satisfaction.
* Use data, experimentation, customer insights, and qualitative feedback to make evidence-based product decisions.
* Identify product opportunities through customer research, market trends, competitive analysis, and business performance.
* Define success metrics, track product performance, and drive continuous optimisation.
* Proactively identify product risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and execution challenges and drive them to closure.
* Mentor and guide product team members and contribute to building a high-performing product culture.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Engineering background — B.E./B.Tech or equivalent technical education preferred.
* Strong product management experience, with demonstrated ownership of products from concept to launch and scale.
* Prior experience in FinTech / Lending / Payments / Financial Services is strongly preferred.
* Experience in Internet, e-commerce, consumer technology, or other high-scale digital businesses is also highly relevant.
* Experience building and managing customer-facing digital products/assets.
Proven track record of shipping products and features at scale, not just managing requirements.
* Strong experience in stakeholder management, including working with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
* Prior experience in team management / mentoring / product team leadership.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience operating in fast-paced product environments.
* Ability to independently manage multiple mainstream/high-impact projects simultaneously, while maintaining prioritisation and execution discipline.
* Strong understanding of product analytics, experimentation, funnels, conversion metrics, and customer behaviour.
* Hands-on experience using AI/GenAI in product development or business use cases.
* Candidates should be comfortable discussing practical AI applications; practical AI use cases will be evaluated during the interview.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex problems and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

Why Join Us

- Work on one of India's most critical financial infrastructure products — UPI — at massive scale
- Join a high-performance product org with strong engineering depth and a bias for shipping

- Operate in a fast-moving, ownership-driven culture where PMs have real authority — and real accountability

About Us:  Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Team : The Merchant Lending team is one of the fastest-growing business verticals at Paytm, focused on enabling credit access to millions of merchants across India. The team drives credit penetration, loan lifecycle management, and cross-sell of high-value financial products like Gold SIP, Insurance, and other merchant-centric financial Solutions.

About the Role: Paytm is looking for an experienced Sales Leader & People Manager to drive the Merchant Lending business across the assigned region. The role involves scaling merchant loan penetration, strengthening underwriting funnel quality, and unlocking incremental revenue through strategic cross-sell initiatives. Expectations/ Requirements:

1. Grow Merchant Lending penetration and overall credit distribution in the assigned geography.
2.⁠Drive visibility & deployment of lending products—Merchant Loans, BNPL, QR-linked credit, overdraft lines, etc.
3.⁠Lead cross-sell of financial products like Gold SIP, Insurance, and other merchant financial tools to enhance merchant stickiness and revenue-per-merchant.
4.⁠Identify, recruit, and manage a strong field sales team to accelerate lending acquisition and cross-sell outputs. 5.⁠Define market size, span, funnel metrics, and territories for Team Leads to maximise efficiency.
6.⁠Ensure seamless communication of plans/targets, minimising expectation vs delivery gaps.
7.⁠Monitor and improve portfolio quality metrics—repayment behaviour, fraud checks, documentation hygiene, and onboarding quality.
8.⁠Conduct audits and validations on loan files, sales processes, and cross-sell adherence.
9.⁠Lead and mentor a large on-ground structure of 5–10 Team Leads & 100+ indirect employees, ensuring high productivity and compliance.

Why Join Us:
1.  A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology 
2.  Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
3.  A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
4.  Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation : If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you
With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Role Overview

We are looking for a senior Sales Planning & Distribution Strategy leader to drive data-led planning and distribution strategy for a large-scale field sales organisation. The role will focus on network planning, manpower optimisation, territory design, productivity improvement and capability building.

Key Responsbilities

• Lead Sales Planning and Distribution Strategy for a large field organisation.
• Develop manpower and network plans based on business potential, productivity and market requirements.
• Design and optimise territories, locations and field-force deployment.
• Use business data and analytics to identify productivity gaps and improve sales output.
• Develop frameworks for workforce planning, capacity planning and productivity management.
• Build and strengthen sales capabilities, processes and planning mechanisms.
• Work closely with business, sales and analytics teams to drive data-backed decisions.
• Identify opportunities to improve the utilisation of the existing distribution network and merchant relationships across multiple products.
• Build scalable planning models that can support future business growth.
• Lead and mentor a small team of 1–2 data/analytics resources supporting planning and execution.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 10+ years of overall experience, preferably in Sales Strategy, Distribution Strategy, Sales Planning, Network Planning or Sales Transformation.
• Experience working with large-scale field sales or distribution teams.
• Strong understanding of manpower planning, territory planning and distribution/network optimisation.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with business data and translate insights into actionable plans.
• Experience designing planning frameworks and processes rather than only executing existing plans.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Demonstrated experience in capability building and improving sales productivity.
• Experience in FMCG, Telecom, BFSI, Fintech, Consumer Internet or other large-scale distribution-led businesses is preferred.
• Candidates from reputed organisations with strong strategic, analytical and distribution exposure would be preferred.
• Preferably MBA from a premier institute.

About Us: 
Paytm is India’s leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. A pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution, Paytm builds technology that enables small businesses and consumers to participate in the digital economy. About the Team:
The Credit Risk Product Team is at the core of our lending operations, ensuring that our risk assessment models are efficient, scalable, and compliant with regulatory frameworks. The team collaborates closely with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to develop and enhance credit risk models, decisioning frameworks, and risk mitigation strategies. By leveraging advanced analytics and machine learning, the team continuously refines underwriting processes to optimize loan performance and reduce defaults.

About the Role:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Credit Analyst to join our risk management team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for implementing credit risk policies, optimizing risk policies, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. You will work closely with data scientists, product managers, and credit teams to enhance our underwriting models and decisioning frameworks.

Key Responsibilities:
* Analyze credit risk across various products, including merchant and personal loans, postpaid.
* Liaison with the business team to understand the credit risk policies and implement the same on platform.
* Implement the credit risk policies on our proprietary platform.
* Monitor performance of credit risk policies. Share feedback with product and Policy team what's working well and what needs improvement. 
* Utilize alternative data sources, machine learning models, and traditional credit assessment techniques to enhance risk evaluation.
* Conduct testing and scenario analysis to measure policy resilience.
* Monitor key risk indicators (KRIs) and provide actionable insights to management.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines and internal risk policies.
* Collaborate with product and technology teams to integrate risk- based decision-making into lending processes.

Requirements:
* 1-3 years of experience, preferably in a fintech or banking environment.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, for data analysis and manipulation.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and collaborate across teams.
* Education qualification: B.Tech- NIT/BITS or any other reputed institutions
 
Why Join us?
Bragging rights to be behind the largest fintech lending play in India.
A fun, energetic and a once-in-a-lifetime environment that enables you to achieve your best possible outcome in your career.

This is a hands-on role centered on owning and running growth campaigns end-to-end, from increasing awareness and reach, to improving conversion, retention, and monetization.
