* Where is the funnel leaking?
* Which cohorts are behaving differently?
* What are the biggest levers to grow loan disbursals?
* Which user journeys or product flows are broken or inefficient?

* Own end-to-end planning and execution of growth campaigns across channels (in- app, push, SMS, email) to drive Postpaid awareness, activation, and usage.
* Discover and define user cohorts that behave differently (e.g., by credit score
availability, session intensity, geography, product interaction)
* Identify opportunities to increase visibility (impressions), CTR, conversion, and engagement using experiments, segmentation, and campaign innovation.
* Run and evaluate growth experiments (A/B tests, control groups) to find what works,and scale it through campaigns.
* Partner with Product and Business teams to improve in-app journeys, address drop-offs, and reduce friction in loan application flow.
* Own and drive CLM / CRM campaigns end-to-end — from strategy and creative briefing to deployment, monitoring, and course-correction — for retargeting, education, and engagement, always with a lens of outcome-based impact.
* Use tools like SQL and Looker to build dashboards and track campaign and funnel performance at a high level.
* Continuously track funnel health, campaign effectiveness, and market trends to propose new strategic bets.
* Use AI to FastTrack ops, improve efficiency and unlock growth.

* Excellent problem-solving skills, structured thinking, and a bias toward
experimentation and measurement.
* Self-starter with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

Our capabilities extend from fully digitized customer on-boarding, seamless in-app to real time offers and digital customer servicing. We partner with financial institutions and leverage the insights we gather through our ecosystem design and offer innovative and customized financial products to our consumers and merchants.
Personal loans: We offer 24x7x365 small ticket cash out loans, especially targeted towards ‘new to credit’ borrower, fulfilling their instant fund requirements and discretionary spends.

About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Role Overview 
The AM/DM– Legal will support business growth across verticals, with a strong focus on corporate advisory, contract management, and risk mitigation. The role requires close collaboration with business, finance, product, and compliance teams, along with active involvement in structuring and executing business transactions.

Key Responsibilities
Draft, review, red-line, negotiate, and finalize commercial documents (contracts, letters, proposals, and similar instruments), ensuring risk mitigation and legal protection for the organization.
Address and resolve contractual issues arising in engagements with internal stakeholders, partners, service providers, and vendors.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (compliance, product, finance, and business) to implement special projects across verticals on time.
Analyze business requirements, identify legal/commercial issues, and propose practical, implementable solutions.
Ensure strict adherence to internal legal frameworks, mandates, policies, and processes.
Provide end-to-end legal ownership and management of assigned business transactions.
Provide general corporate advisory support; research and assess the legal viability of proposed business models under applicable laws.
Identify risks in existing agreements and assist in revising contract templates and legal processes.
Requirements & Qualifications
Education: LL.B. from a recognized university (Graduates from National Law Schools / DU / ILS / Symbiosis preferred).
Experience: 3+ years of experience in end-to-end contract management, with mandatory experience in a law firm.
Legal Acumen: Strong legal expertise paired with interpersonal skills to communicate and coordinate complex issues across diverse stakeholder groups.
Execution: High attention to detail with strong drafting, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.
Autonomy: Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver outcomes efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Word and MS Office tools.

Sales Executive / Sr. Sales Executive — Motor Insurance
Department: Paytm Insurance Broking | Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Role Overview The Sales Executive / Sr. Sales Executive (Motor Insurance) will be responsible for driving sales of motor insurance products (Two-Wheeler, Private Car, and Commercial Vehicle policies). Key Responsibilities
Generate and convert telesales leads specifically for motor insurance products (Two-Wheeler, Four-Wheeler, and Commercial Vehicles).

Assist customers with seamless policy issuances, rollovers, and renewal conversions.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly motor insurance sales targets.

Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Sound knowledge of motor insurance concepts (IDV, NCB transfers, Third-Party vs. Comprehensive cover, Add-ons).
Customer-first mindset with an ability to build rapport quickly.
Analytical thinking to generate insights from lead and sales data.
Ability to work independently as well as in a team-based environment.
Good command of spoken and written English and Hindi.
Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and CRM software.

Qualification & Experience
Graduation (any stream) — MBA or relevant certification in insurance/sales is a plus.
Freshers – 4-5 years of experience in motor insurance telesales or general insurance sales preferred.

Attractive compensation structure with uncapped performance-based incentives.
Opportunity to work with one of the most trusted financial technology brands in India.
Growth-oriented environment with training and advancement opportunities.
Exposure to a wide network of digital distribution channels.

jobs.description_html:
About Us: 
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:
Pi Agents At Pi Agents, we are creating AI agents for businesses. We are building agents that help businesses of all sizes with their day to day challenges, across the full lifecycle: Acquiring, Servicing, Retaining, Upselling, and Supporting customers. We operate like a startup inside Paytm, shipping fast with a small, senior team.

 About the role: 
This role is for the SMB Growth Agents. You will own product outcomes for growth-focused agents serving small and medium Indian businesses, taking them from capability to measurable business impact at scale.

Expectations/Requirements:
1. Own the SMB Growth Agents roadmap end to end, from problem discovery to GTM and adoption.
2. Define and own outcome metrics: merchant activation, campaign performance, incremental revenue, retention.
3. Design agent experiences that self-serve SMB merchants can trust and use daily: onboarding, goal setting, autonomous execution, and clear reporting. 4. Set and enforce a very high bar for UX and UI.
5. SMB users have low tolerance for friction; the agent experience must be simple, vernacular-friendly, and mobile-first.
6. Work with engineering and data science on agent architecture tradeoffs: latency, cost per merchant, guardrails, evals.
7. Run structured experimentation to prove agent-driven lift over merchant self-managed baselines. Partner with sales, ops, and support to scale from pilot cohorts to the long tail


Superpowers/Skills that will help you succeed in this role:
1. 5-9 yrs of Product Management experience, Tier-1 institute preferred.
2. Strong B2C product experience; experience dealing with small to medium size Indian businesses is a plus.
3. Sets a very high bar for UX and UI, with a portfolio of shipped experiences that demonstrate craft.
4. Data driven decision making: fluency in analytics suites (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Clever Tap), SQL, and experiment design.
5. Hands-on experience building AI native or agentic products is a strong plus; understanding of prompt design, evals, and agent orchestration preferred.
6. Comfort with ambiguity and a 0-to-1 environment; bias for shipping and learning weekly

Why join us: 
A collaborative, output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology. You will build one of India's first at-scale agentic AI products for businesses, with direct revenue accountability.

Compensation: If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants, and the depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to build India's largest AI-led business growth story, and you can be part of it.

jobs.description_html:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.   

Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.  

It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.  

Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.  

In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company. 


The Role  


Nium is looking for a Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering to lead the teams responsible for the availability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence of our global payments platform. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will build and grow a team of SREs, define the reliability roadmap, and partner closely with product engineering, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure Nium's systems meet the always-on expectations of a regulated financial platform operating across 100+ markets. 

You will own incident management, observability, capacity planning, and production readiness practices, while championing a culture of blameless postmortems, proactive risk reduction, and engineering-driven automation. This role sits at the intersection of engineering leadership and operational rigor, and reports into Nium's engineering leadership.

Nium, the Leader in Real-Time Global Payments 
 
Nium, the leading global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments, was founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. With the onset of the global economy, its payments infrastructure is shaping how banks, fintechs, and businesses everywhere collect, convert, and disburse funds instantly across borders. Its payout network supports 100 currencies and spans 190+ countries, 100 of which in real-time. Funds can be disbursed to accounts, wallets, and cards and collected locally in 40 markets. Nium's growing card issuance business is already available in 34 countries. Nium holds regulatory licenses and authorizations in more than 40 countries, enabling seamless onboarding, rapid integration, and compliance – independent of geography. The company is co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore.

About the role

 

Nium is seeking a motivated Sr Reporting Analyst to join our dynamic global finance team. This is an excellent opportunity to work closely with the VP of Finance and Director of Reporting on global accounting, audit, and reporting initiatives. This candidate will be the point person on financial reporting and technical accounting at the company and focus on keeping audits and reporting on track.

jobs.description_html:
About Us:  Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Role Overview
We are looking for a high-ownership Project/Program Manager to lead AI-led transformation initiatives across the Lending Collections ecosystem.
This role sits at the intersection of Business, Product, Technology, Data, and AI. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable understanding a business problem, translating it into a structured product/technology requirement, driving engineering execution, and taking the initiative all the way to production and measurable business impact.
This is not a traditional project-management role. We are looking for someone who can own the problem statement, bring structure to ambiguity, drive stakeholders, and turn AI opportunities into production-grade solutions.

Key Responsibilities
1. Business Requirement & Problem Discovery
Work closely with Business and Collections stakeholders to identify operational pain points, automation opportunities, and AI use cases.
Conduct requirement-gathering workshops and translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements.
Challenge requirements where necessary and bring structure to ambiguous problem statements.
Understand lending collections journeys, customer touchpoints, workflows, operational processes, and relevant business metrics.
2. BRD, Workflow & Solution Documentation
Create and maintain detailed BRDs, functional requirements, user stories, process flows, workflows, and solution documentation.
Define end-to-end process journeys, including inputs, outputs, decisioning logic, exceptions, dependencies, and integrations.
Convert business requirements into granular user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
Ensure documentation remains aligned with the evolving product and technology solution.
3. AI & Automation Program Management
Identify and evaluate opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI automation, LLMs, and intelligent workflows within lending collections.
Work with AI/Tech teams to translate business use cases into viable AI solutions.
Understand the capabilities and limitations of AI technologies and challenge proposed solutions constructively.
Drive AI initiatives from ideation → requirement → solutioning → development → testing → deployment → adoption → measurement.
Track business outcomes and ensure AI initiatives deliver measurable improvements in productivity, collections, customer experience, or operational efficiency.
4. Technology & Engineering Collaboration
Act as the bridge between Business/Product and Engineering.
Clearly communicate the “what” and “why” behind requirements to technology teams.
Break complex requirements into executable user stories and development milestones.
Work closely with Engineering, Data, AI/ML, QA, and other technology teams to resolve dependencies and blockers.
Ensure the technology team has sufficient clarity to execute without repeated requirement ambiguity.
Participate actively in solution discussions, technical walkthroughs, testing, UAT, and production readiness.
5. Program Governance & Execution
Own project/program trackers and maintain complete visibility on milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, owners, and timelines.
Drive regular governance forums and stakeholder reviews.
Proactively identify risks and unblock teams rather than waiting for escalations.
Manage cross-functional dependencies across Business, Product, Technology, Data, Operations, and external partners.
Drive initiatives firmly towards closure, adoption, and business outcomes.
6. Data & Analytics
Should be comfortable using SQL to independently fetch, analyse, and validate data required for product and business decisions.
Work with Data/Analytics teams to define data requirements and validate outputs.
Use data to size opportunities, validate assumptions, monitor performance, and measure the impact of AI initiatives.
Ability to translate data insights into actionable product/program decisions.

Must-Have Skills
Project / Program Management experience, preferably in FinTech, Lending, Banking, Collections, or Financial Services.
Strong understanding of lending and collections processes.
Excellent requirement-gathering and stakeholder-management skills.
Strong capability to create BRDs, FRDs, workflows, process maps, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Proven ability to drive Technology/Engineering teams and manage delivery end-to-end.
Hands-on proficiency with JIRA for backlog, sprint, issue, and project management.
Working knowledge of Figma for reviewing/contributing to product flows, wireframes, and user journeys.
Strong understanding of AI/GenAI/LLMs/Agentic AI and automation use cases.
Working proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
High ownership, strong execution bias, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity.

Good-to-Have
Experience working on AI agents, conversational AI, LLM-powered workflows, RAG, AI copilots, or intelligent automation.
Experience integrating AI solutions with existing enterprise systems/APIs.
Understanding of collections technology platforms, dialers, CRM, payment systems, customer communication platforms, or workflow engines.
Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Experience managing multiple concurrent AI/product initiatives.
Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
Experience defining AI success metrics, evaluation frameworks, and operational KPIs.

What Success Looks Like
Within this role, the candidate should be able to take a statement such as:
“Can we use AI to improve this part of the collections journey?”
…and independently drive it through:
Business problem → Opportunity sizing → Requirement discovery → BRD → Workflow → AI solution definition → User stories → Tech execution → Testing/UAT → Production → Adoption → Business impact.
The right candidate will be someone who doesn't merely maintain a tracker—they own the outcome.
Experience
3-4 years of relevant experience in Project/Program Management, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Technology Program Management, with meaningful exposure to FinTech/Lending/Collections and AI/Automation.
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Finance, or a related discipline. MBA/PGDM is a plus.

Why Join Us:
1.  A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology 
2.  Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
3.  A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
4.  Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation : If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you
With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

About the Team
 

The Commerce Platform team at Meesho drives end-to-end growth, strategy, and operational excellence across key verticals:

- User Growth: Scales the full lifecycle funnel—from acquisition and activation to retention—ensuring sustainable user growth and engagement

across the platform.

executable programs.

underlying customer and business dynamics, and use these insights to set direction and deliver measurable outcomes.

jobs.description_html:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.   

Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.  

It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.  

Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.  

In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company. 


We are hiring a Senior Manager to take ownership of safeguarding for NIUM's UK regulated entities, covering both emoney and payment services activities under the Electronic Money Regulations 2011, Payment Services Regulations 2017, and the FCA's CASS15 sourcebook. This is a senior, hands-on, first-line role combining regulatory ownership, treasury decision-making, and 4-eyes oversight of operational work across the group. 

You will be the day-to-day authority on UK safeguarding compliance; running reconciliation checks, chairing the UK Safeguarding Committee, owning FCA reporting, and acting as the escalation point for safeguarding incidents. You will also make live decisions on UK cash management, diversification, and interest optimisation, working closely with Compliance and the Director of Safeguarding to keep UK processes aligned to group standards while staying compliant with UK-specific regulatory requirements. 

This is a fast-paced, high-visibility role in a business operating across 40+ regulated jurisdictions, you will need to be comfortable making sound decisions quickly as rules, products, and volumes evolve.

jobs.description_html:
Nium, the Leader in Real-Time Global Payments 
 
Nium, the leading global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments, was founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. With the onset of the global economy, its payments infrastructure is shaping how banks, fintechs, and businesses everywhere collect, convert, and disburse funds instantly across borders. Its payout network supports 100 currencies and spans 190+ countries, 100 of which in real-time. Funds can be disbursed to accounts, wallets, and cards and collected locally in 40 markets. Nium's growing card issuance business is already available in 34 countries. Nium holds regulatory licenses and authorizations in more than 40 countries, enabling seamless onboarding, rapid integration, and compliance – independent of geography. The company is co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore.

About the Role: 
 

Join our Risk & Compliance team as a Data Engineer supporting Regulatory Reporting and Portfolio Intelligence initiatives. You will work closely with Country Compliance, Money Laundering Reporting Officers (MLROs), Risk, and Product teams to build the data infrastructure that powers regulatory compliance, reporting, and portfolio management across Nium's global operations.

This is a technical role with a strong regulatory edge - you'll not only architect and implement scalable data pipelines and connectors, but also help translate complex regulatory requirements into actionable data solutions. You'll be a bridge between compliance/risk domain expertise and technical data engineering, ensuring our regulatory data is accurate, auditable, and readily available for both internal decision-making and regulatory submissions.

Key aspects of the role:

  • Design and build scalable, maintainable data pipelines for regulatory and compliance data
  • Develop and maintain XML and REST API connectors to ingest data from banking partners, regulatory bodies, and internal systems
  • Implement bit request processing for real-time transaction data integration and portfolio updates
  • Interpret regulatory requirements (transaction reporting, sanctions screening, KYC/AML, portfolio limits) and translate them into data models and processing logic
  • Work directly with Country Compliance, MLRO, Risk, and Product teams to understand data needs and operationalize compliance rules
  • Ensure all data flows are auditable, traceable, and compliant with regulatory standards and internal policies

About Us:
Paytm is India’s leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. A pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution, Paytm builds technology that enables small businesses and consumers to participate in the digital economy. About the Role:
We are looking for a strategic and data-driven Growth leader to own and scale growth for the Paytm for Business app. The role will be responsible for driving activation, engagement, retention and winback, with a strong focus on improving service-led product journeys and building a scalable growth engine.

The ideal candidate will combine strong product and growth thinking with deep expertise in analytics, experimentation and lifecycle marketing. This is a high-ownership role that will work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing and Business teams to identify growth opportunities, design interventions and drive measurable outcomes at scale.

Key Responsibilities:
- Own the growth charter for the Paytm for Business app, covering activation, engagement, retention and win back.
- Identify opportunities across key service product journeys and build strategies to improve user adoption, usage and retention.
- Build a data-led growth engine using user analytics, cohort analysis, funnel metrics and behavioral insights.
- Drive a strong culture of experimentation and rapid iteration, including hypothesis creation, A/B testing and measurement of business impact.
- Own and scale lifecycle marketing / CLM initiatives across user segments and stages of the customer journey.
- Leverage AI and Agentic capabilities to automate growth workflows, personalization, customer lifecycle management and decision-making.
- Define and track growth KPIs, identify gaps and translate insights into actionable product and business initiatives.
- Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Design and Operations teams to execute growth initiatives.
- Develop and own growth charters based on evolving business priorities and identify new avenues for sustainable growth.
- Lead and mentor a high-performing growth team, fostering strong ownership, analytical thinking and execution excellence.
- Continuously benchmark industry trends, consumer behavior and competitive offerings to identify new growth opportunities.


What We’re Looking For:
- Strong academic pedigree; Tier-1 institute preferred.
- Experience in Tier-1 product, consumer internet or fintech companies, preferably in high-scale growth environments.
- Proven experience in product growth, lifecycle marketing / CLM and app growth across activation, engagement, retention and win back.
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking with the ability to translate data into business outcomes.
- Hands-on experience with experimentation, growth analytics, segmentation and personalization.
- Experience leveraging AI / Agentic capabilities to automate or enhance growth and customer lifecycle management.
- Strong people-management experience with the ability to lead and scale growth charters.
- Excellent stakeholder-management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
- High ownership, structured problem-solving ability and a strong bias for execution.
- Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous and highly data-driven environment.

 Why join us : 
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.   

Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.  

It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.  

Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.  

In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

Department: Finance / Operations Location: Corporate Office / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-time Experience Required: 2–4 Years (SAP Mandatory)

Position Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Operations & SAP Executive to manage end-to-end
vendor operations, procurement workflows, invoice processing, and employee reimbursement
functions. In this role, you will act as a critical liaison between internal departments and external
vendors, maintaining accurate tracking systems, processing transactions in SAP, and ensuring
operational compliance with internal financial policies.

Key Responsibilities
Vendor Management & User Coordination
 Point of Contact: Serve as the primary liaison between external vendors and internal cross-
functional teams for operational queries.
 Vendor Onboarding: Coordinate end-to-end vendor onboarding processes, ensuring full compliance
with tax, banking, and documentation requirements.
 Relationship Management: Maintain proactive communication with vendors to resolve payment,
invoice, or PO-related discrepancies promptly.
Procurement & SAP Operations
 PR & PO Creation: Generate and process Purchase Requisitions (PR) and Purchase Orders (PO)
accurately in SAP as well as internal workflow platforms.
 Scope & Approval Verification: Verify scope of work, departmental approvals, and budget
allocations prior to issuing official POs.
 System Maintenance: Ensure all procurement entries, item masters, and vendor records within SAP
reflect up-to-date data.
Invoice Processing & Tracker Management
 Invoice Processing: Receive, audit, and process high-volume vendor invoices against active POs and
delivery/service sign-offs.
 Tracker Management: Maintain meticulous, real-time Excel/system trackers to record invoice
status, approval stages, and payment dates.
 Accounts Payable Coordination: Collaborate closely with Finance and Accounts Payable teams to
ensure adherence to payment cycles and avoid delays.
Employee Reimbursements & Advances
 Reimbursement Auditing: Review and process employee expense reimbursement requests and
travel claims in compliance with company policy.
 Advance Management: Handle petty cash and employee advance requests, tracking settlements
and verifying supporting documents/receipts.

Qualifications & Key Requirements
 Experience: 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in procurement support, finance operations,
vendor management, or accounts payable.
 SAP Proficiency: Direct operational experience with SAP (specifically MM/FI modules) is
MANDATORY.
 Technical Skills: Strong working proficiency in MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, tracker
maintenance) and internal ticket management systems.
 Detail Orientation: High accuracy in numerical data entry, document verification, and maintain
ledger/tracker consistency.
 Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for effective coordination across
internal departments and external vendors.
 Time Management: Ability to prioritize tasks, meet tight payment and processing schedules, and
handle operational follow-ups independently.

Key Responsibilities • SDLC & Program Delivery: Plan, manage, and drive execution of technical programs across the full SDLC — from requirements and design through development, testing, release, and post-launch support.

About Tetriz

Tetriz helps engineering orgs become AI-native, faster.
Observability that turns AI blind spots into measured signals, coaching that improves how engineers direct AI, and governance that catches risk without surveillance.

The role

This is an Associate Product Marketing Manager (APMM) role. 

Most of our marketing already runs on AI agents. We have a content engine built on Claude (for SEO blogs, founder LinkedIn content, Reddit programs, YouTube scripts), outbound infrastructure on Apollo/Hubspot, and competitive intelligence workflows.

If your instinct when given a repetitive task is "I should build a skill/workflow for this," you'll fit. If your instinct is to open a blank doc, this will frustrate you.

What you'll own

1. Content engine

  • Run the SEO blog pipeline end to end: briefs, drafts, editorial QA against our standards, publishing, and refresh cycles

  • Ship LinkedIn posts and company page content on a weekly calendar

  • Draft and iterate YouTube scripts, titles, descriptions, and thumbnails for CTR

  • Keep website and landing page copy current; run CRO experiments as traffic scales

2. Outbound and growth ops

  • Own the email and social media outbound machine: Sequences, list building and enrichment, deliverability hygiene

  • Experiment with new outbound channels every quarter

  • Track and report campaign performance weekly; kill what's not working

3. Launch and channel presence

  • Run launch-week execution, across relevant platforms.

  • Build and maintain our G2 and Capterra presence: profile setup, review generation campaigns, response management

  • Engage in relevant communities where our buyers actually are

4. Lifecycle and customer marketing

  • Own the PLG email lifecycle: onboarding nurture for new signups, activation prompts, and executive-facing ROI report emails

  • Produce case studies and capture named customer quotes from active deployments

  • Keep sales assets current: pitch deck updates, one-pagers, battlecards, teaser video iterations.

What we need

  • 2–3 years in B2B marketing execution. SaaS strongly preferred, dev-tools or selling-to-engineers a big plus

  • AI-native. You use Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor daily as a working tool, not a novelty. You can show us prompts, workflows, or agents you've built to do your job faster. This is the single biggest filter.

  • Strong communication skills. You'll edit AI output for a technical US audience, you need the judgment to catch what's generic, wrong, or off-brand

  • Ops discipline. Outbound infrastructure fails quietly. You check the dashboard before anyone asks

Nice to have: experience with Apollo.io, Hubspot or similar sales engagement tools, basic SEO fundamentals, familiarity with the developer tools ecosystem, video editing basics.

What you'll get

  • A front-row seat to a US GTM launch, working directly with the founders

  • The most AI-leveraged marketing stack you'll find at any company this size, you'll build skills most marketers won't have for years

  • Real ownership from week one. No approval chains, no busywork

jobs.description_html:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.   

Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.  

It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.  

Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.  

In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company. 


The increasing volume, complexity, and regulatory scrutiny of financial‑crime and compliance risks requires advanced, data‑driven capabilities that traditional analytics and manual processes can no longer support. The Compliance Data Scientist will significantly enhance Nium’s ability to detect emerging risks, optimise controls, meet regulatory expectations, and drive operational efficiency across the compliance function. 

This role fills a critical capability gap and directly supports strategic priorities including automation, risk‑based decisioning, model optimisation, data‑quality improvement, and regulatory assurance. Additionally, this role is specifically designed to support activities related to transitioning compliance systems to advanced, data-driven Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning solutions e.g. Transaction Monitoring detection models. 

Role Summary: 

  • Responsible for development of AI/ML models to identify risks (such as fraud or credit risk) while ensuring these models are auditable, explainable, and compliant with data privacy laws 

  • Understand the coverage and accuracy of the existing rules for anti-money laundering and financial crimes 

  • Support rules management process to ensure rules are performing to expected thresholds    

  • Support the integrity, accuracy, and usability of data across compliance and financial crime functions.  

  • Develops data dashboards to provide visibility of performance of rules and models  

  • Leverage advanced analytics to understand cause and effect relationships  

  • Understand data quality and labelling, perform advanced analysis to identify high predictive strength variables, and work with technology teams on availability of variables.
